description: React component for the main page of a recipe explorer web app, including data loading, filtering, recipe selection, and rendering of recipe list and details.

methods.name: uniqueSorted
methods.description: Creates a sorted list of unique, non-empty trimmed strings from an array.

methods.name: recipeMatches
methods.description: Filters recipes based on the current filter state, matching title, tags, cuisine, and maximum minutes.

methods.name: updateFilter
methods.description: Updates filter state based on user input.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Resets all filters to their default empty state.
